reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for connecting to PowerContext over HTTP to recall and capture context and expose memory, handoff, experience, skill, and review operations.

summaries.zh: 通过 HTTP 连接 PowerContext，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文召回、用户输入捕获以及记忆、交接和技能相关操作。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to PowerContext over HTTP for context recall, user-input capture, and memory, handoff, experience, skill, and review operations.

capabilities: Connects to a PowerContext Server over HTTP
Recalls and injects bounded historical context before model steps
Captures user input as stored content sources
Provides memory, handoff, experience, skill, and read-only review tools
